name: 2020 CUSPE Policy Challenge - How Can We Use Community-Based Resources to Jointly Tackle the Climate Emergency within Our Communities?

description: Using literature reviews, surveys, and interviews with local community groups, this report paints a wide-ranging picture of the ways community development and the health and wellbeing of residents are strongly connected and charts a course of action for the Council to help maximise the benefits of this connection locally.

description: Using literature reviews, case studies, and the piloting of evaluation techniques with citizens, this report develops a framework for evaluating an asset-based community development (ABCD) initiative like the Healthy Fenland Fund, which can be used to assess the effectiveness of the initiative in meeting its desired outcomes.

description: Connected to the work behind the “Net Zero Cambridgeshire” report, this report takes a closer look at carbon emissions in the transport sector in Cambridgeshire specifically, estimating the baseline emissions for the sector through to 2050 and using case studies from around the world to evidence the most effective policies in reducing emissions.

description: Researched and written in the midst of Cambridgeshire County Council’s declaration of a climate emergency and providing an evidence base for the Council’s Climate and Environment Strategy, this report sets out the baseline of carbon emissions across multiple sectors in Cambridgeshire and the nature of the County’s challenge of approaching net zero carbon emissions by 2050.
name: 2019 CUSPE Policy Challenge - Net Zero Cambridgeshire
